instruction: Design a 1-bit wide, 256-to-1 multiplexer using Verilog. The 256 inputs are all packed into a single 256-bit input vector. The select line should be a 8-bit binary number, with sel[0] selecting in[0], sel[1] selecting in[1], etc. The module should be implemented using a hierarchical architecture, with smaller multiplexers being used to build up the larger 256-to-1 multiplexer.
label: trojan
